evidence_backed_explanation: Ten independent open coffee-specific dataset candidates were identified.
Fourteen controlled-sensory candidates were identified; upstream forms and raw participant records remain governed separately.
Eleven independent consumer-study origins plus one mirror were reviewed.

Only four credible structured specialty-catalog families were identified after repository, catalog-provider, and multilingual searches; additional results were live storefronts without stable data access or upstream-copy rights.

Only three independent official competition or auction families with identifiable lot-level sensory material were verified; country editions under one auction operator are not inflated into separate families.

Only six credible source-authored or mirror families were identified; most coffee-review search results were scraped copies, all-rights-reserved pages, or education prose rather than licensed tasting archives.

Only Open Food Facts and FoodRepo exposed credible general-product schemas with a possible descriptive field; national nutrient tables located in portal searches did not contain source-authored coffee tasting notes and were not padded into the frame.

Seven high-yield permission, partnership, or license options were reviewed, representing six independent families because the RoasterDB sample and full license share one upstream family; no purchase, request, contract, or scraping action was authorized.
Twelve independent community/platform families were identified; all remain behind official-API, written-permission, privacy, and model-use gates.
